Your next few Fridays, sorted 🗓️

@whoisconway brings out Ghostface, Raekwon and Method Man on OTIS this Friday. Same day, @danz_cm (the voice behind Computer Magic) drops her new album. Then @dontoliver closes it out Dec 4 with Nitrous.

Which one's first in your queue?

Find the next ones before everyone else. Get on the waitlist at riffex.app.
